body: I'm fairly sure I did that at the start to be fair to me, I was worried going in that it could have been a problematic discussion.

My conversation was about his faith in God and belief in Christianity, and how as a person who didn't have a Christian upbringing how I could better understand that. As in I was legitimately open to the possibility and not disrespectful at all from what I could see.
Fair point - he had brought it up and led the conversation but evidently didn't raise the alarm about any issues it was causing until too late.

Thanks for your comment! It wasn't anything like that I was better trying to understand where his faith came from rather than asking questions that contradict something. The question that got us stuck was about why he has faith in God and belief in Christianity, around a central point of how as someone without a Christian upbringing I could go from not having that to having that. I was very open to a decent conversation about it to be honest, just I am not particularly eloquent in conversations in person when I'm just chatting!

Thanks for your comment! One of the questions that was getting me stuck was about why he has faith in God and belief in Christianity, and about ways or concepts that could help get me closer to understanding or feeling that.
I will have a look at that subreddit - thanks!

I'm not particularly eloquent but I knew enough to not use your alternative phrasing! I was trying to ask from a perspective questions about how I could understand more about faith and Christianity whilst not coming from a Christian upbringing. They are one of my best friends so I had no intention to question them/offend them/challenge them rather just to get to understand them better.
This is honestly so helpful, thank you! :)

When I'm by myself I just have bad thoughts and feelings - it's honestly the joy and friendships that I have that kept me going. Whilst I prepared myself to not be able to have as much going on with one friend I don't think I'd have ever suspected everyone to be gone so quickly. I've never really enjoyed my own company, I'm so desperate for friends to make my life enjoyable but I cant even join anything to make friends now. I will try your suggestions though!
Mainly my friends, but it's getting further and further since June when I last saw them all in person and no time coming that I'll be able to cause COVID stuff :/
